mapper.select: SELECT NAME_ as 'processName' , count(NAME_) as 'processNumber' from act_hi_procinst where TENANT_ID_ = #{tenantId} and NAME_ != '' GROUP BY NAME_ ORDER BY count(NAME_) desc
SELECT SUM(END_TIME_ is null) AS '运行流程', COUNT(END_TIME_) AS '结束流程', COUNT(DELETE_REASON_ ) AS '强制终止流程' FROM act_hi_procinst

SELECT to_char(END_TIME_, 'YYYY-mm') mont, count(*) 'coun'
SELECT date_format(END_TIME_, '%Y-%m') mont, count(*) 'coun'
FROM act_hi_taskinst WHERE TENANT_ID_ = #{tenantId} AND END_TIME_ is not null AND assignee_ = #{userId}
GROUP BY to_char(END_TIME_, 'YYYY-mm')
GROUP BY date_format(END_TIME_, '%Y-%m')
